description: Official Federal Reserve H.10 data for exchange-rate unit roots and ARCH/GARCH teaching applications.

source.provider: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US)
source.units: US dollars to one euro; not seasonally adjusted
source.definition: Noon buying rates in New York City for cable transfers payable in foreign currencies.
source.licence: Public domain; Federal Reserve/FRED citation retained.

preparation.missing_policy: Omit dates with no published quotation; no interpolation, forward filling or zero-return insertion.
preparation.monthly_aggregation: Last available H.10 quotation in each calendar month; actual observation date retained in the monthly CSV.
preparation.daily_analysis: 2021-2025; calculate changes from the complete daily extract before selecting the sample.
preparation.monthly_analysis: 2010-01 to 2025-12; December 2009 provides only the first-change base.
preparation.transform: 100 * difference of natural log of USD per EUR. Positive change means euro appreciation against the dollar.
preparation.return_scope: Exchange-rate log changes, not interest-inclusive currency investment or excess returns.
